I've retextured the Character for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27009]Lime Tree's Maid Bella Dwellin (Original)[/url]﻿ mod based on Portrait HD on Skime.﻿﻿
[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]♡ [/color][color=#f4cccc]♡ [/color][color=#f4cccc]♡[/color] 

Must download original mod first [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27009][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27009]Lime Tree's Maid Bella Dwellin (Original)[/url]

[color=#bf9000][u]How to Use Character files [/u][/color]
Character B_C.png needs to be added to Stardew Valley\Mods\Bella Dwellin SDV\assets\Characters

[color=#bf9000][u]How to use Bella's Portrait HD file [/u][/color]

To use [color=#1e84cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portrait HD[/url]﻿[/color] it is necessary to download the Portraiture mod and read the HD mod manual.
For example, if I create any folder and name it Abcxyz, the directory path will be Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\Abcxyz
I'm going to add Portrait Bella.png to Abcxyz

[color=#e06666]Make sure the png photo name is Bella

[/color]
